name: Tube Investments of India Ltd.
business_summary: Murugappa-group engineering company: standalone precision steel tubes, chains, car door frames/metal-formed parts, bicycles and strips (Q1 FY27 standalone revenue Rs 2,366 cr, +18%), plus subsidiaries CG Power (majority-owned, consolidated, ~Rs 12.4k cr revenue), Shanthi Gears, TI Clean Mobility (EV; loss Rs 147 cr in Q1), a semiconductor venture (loss Rs 50 cr) and a new 76.24% stake in Orange Koi. Consolidated EBITDA is dominated by CG Power; the market values TII below its CG stake alone. Promoters 44.1%, FIIs 21.5%.

exposures.mechanism: Standalone engineering (tubes, strips, chains, metal-formed) steel ~45% of standalone sales (~Rs 9.5k cr/yr, model estimate). +7% -> ~Rs 300 cr cost; ~75% recovered by contractual pass-through with a lag -> ~Rs 75 cr unrecovered = ~7.5% of standalone EBITDA (~Rs 1,000 cr); standalone ~40% of TII market value x persistence 0.4 = -1.2; set at -1.4 to reflect the Q1 margin compression of 194bp. Pack empirical global HRC -1.80 per +10% (t -1.7) has the same sign. Management says inflation will be recovered 'over the coming quarters' (expectation, not outcome).

evidence.note: Standalone EBITDA margin down 194bp to 10.39% on rising material consumption
Management expects input-cost inflation to be fully recovered over coming quarters

exposures.mechanism: Metal-formed (car door frames), chains and tubes for autos ~40% of standalone revenue. +10% auto volumes -> +4% standalone revenue; contribution ~30% vs EBITDA margin ~10% -> EBITDA +12% of standalone; x0.4 value share x0.3 persistence = +1.4 after rounding up for capacity additions. Standalone engineering revenue +20.6% in Q1.

evidence.note: Engineering segment standalone revenue Rs 1,566 cr, +20.64%

exposures.mechanism: Metal-formed rail components (new customer plants in rail per Kalkine): rail ~5% of standalone revenue; +10% rail capex -> +0.5% standalone revenue -> +1.5% EBITDA x0.4 x0.5 = +0.3, rounded 0.4.

evidence.note: FY27 capex plan includes supplies linked to new customer plants in automotive and rail

exposures.mechanism: Industrial tubes, Shanthi Gears and engineering capital goods linked to private capex ~25% of standalone: +10% capex growth -> +3% revenue -> +9% EBITDA x0.4 x0.3 = +1.1, trimmed to 0.8. Excludes CG Power, which flows through the holding link.

evidence.note: Larger FY27 capex excl. CG Power incl. new Nashik facility

exposures.mechanism: TI Clean Mobility revenue Rs 239 cr (+77%) but loss Rs 147 cr in Q1 FY27 (Rs 136 cr a year earlier), plus Rs 50 cr semiconductor loss; TII injected Rs 250 cr more on 2026-09-29. Stronger EV support (+1) -> TICM loss -30% = +Rs 175 cr/yr = +17% of standalone EBITDA x0.4 value share x0.3 plus less capital drag = +1.5.

evidence.note: EV segment revenue +76.6% to Rs 239 cr; EV subsidiary loss Rs 147 cr; semiconductor loss Rs 50 cr

evidence.source: ET Auto / BusinessLine / Autocar Professional headlines in pack
evidence.note: Rs 250 cr infusion into TI Clean Mobility

exposures.mechanism: Pack empirical -7.24 per +3% USD/CNY (t -3.0). Plausible channel: weaker yuan = cheaper Chinese bicycles, EV components and engineered tubes/chains competing with TII; also a sentiment/regime proxy. Shrunk to about one fifth of the empirical estimate.
Long-duration, P/E ~70x stock funding EV/semiconductor losses; direct interest cost small (interest Rs 62 cr TTM). +25bp -> -0.8 mostly multiple compression. RBI hiked to 5.50% on 2026-10-07.

Standalone exports ~15% of engineering revenue vs imported steel/EV components ~10% -> net small positive; +3% -> +0.4% of standalone revenue x0.4 value share = +0.2-0.3. Pack: no significant USDINR sensitivity in the top 12.

company_links.mechanism: TII is CG Power's majority holder (Kalkine: 'majority holding'); the CG promoter group holds 56.34% (screener Sep 2026); TII's exact share is to be verified (model knowledge ~56-58%). CG is consolidated: CG PAT ~Rs 308 cr in Q1 vs TII consolidated PAT Rs 294 cr with minorities ~Rs 124 cr. Stake value 56% x Rs 1.27 lakh cr = ~Rs 71k cr = 1.6x TII's Rs 43.8k cr market cap: a deep holding-company discount. Structural pass-through would be ~1.0 per +1% CG; the empirical 3-year weekly regression of TII on CG controlling for Nifty 50 gives beta 0.31 (computed from data/prices/close.csv). w = 0.5 blends the two. Unit: % change in TII equity per +1% change in CGPOWER equity.

evidence.note: TII holds a majority stake in CG Power
CG market cap Rs 1,27,103 cr; promoter 56.34%
CG Power and Shanthi Gears reported as subsidiaries; consolidated PAT attributable Rs 170 cr vs total Rs 294 cr (AI-generated summary; treat with caution)

supply_chain.note: Q1 revenue Rs 115 cr (-14%); TII bought another 2.69% on 2026-08-21

supply_chain.counterparty: Maruti, M&M, Tata, Hero (auto OEM customers)
